name: ORKS: NAZDREG
description:
Nazdreg Ug Urdgrub is an infamous Bad Moons warlord – the flashiest of all. His power klaw, Moonchewa, and his multi‑kombi Kustom Blasta X shoota reap a heavy toll as he leads his well-equipped Waaagh! from the front alongside the Toof Rippers, his elite troops. The Flashboss is known for his insatiable greed and mastery of tellyport assaults.

Supreme Kunnin'

This multipart plastic kit builds Nazdreg, a mega-armoured Bad Moons warlord for your Ork armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. His Kustom Blasta X is effectively an arsenal in itself, while his savage power klaw, Moonchewa, can crush everything from enemy leaders to tanks. His inspiring presence can whip nearby Ork units into a killing frenzy. This hulking brute is adorned with flashy details, making it an impressive centrepiece miniature that will look just as stunning on your display shelves as it will leading your armies.

Contents:
– 27 plastic components
– 1 Citadel 60mm Round Base
– 1 construction guide

This miniature requires assembly and is supplied unpainted. We recommend:
– Citadel Tools: Super Fine Detail Cutters
– Warhammer Colour Plastic Glue
– Warhammer Colour paints
